## Left-censored lognormal models with observed discharge and antecedent precipitation

One model type, one set of reported numbers. Each solute is modeled separately with a **left-censored lognormal Bayesian regression** (`brms`):

```         
log(C_j) ~ Normal(mu_j, sigma^2)
mu_j = site_j + b1*sin(2*pi*doy/365.25) + b2*cos(2*pi*doy/365.25) + b3*Q*_j + b4*P*_j + u_stream-date(j)
```

*Predictors:*

- `Q*` = standardized log(1 + discharge in L/s)
- `P*` = standardized log(1 + 3-day cumulative precipitation, mm).

Log transform: the models describe percent-type (multiplicative) changes, and a log scale keeps a few very high flows or storms from dominating. The “1 +” lets days with zero flow or zero rain be used.

*Nondetects:*

- For observations of solutes below detection limits- instead of replacing them with a made-up number (zero or half the limit), the model says “the true value is somewhere below this limit” and uses the probability of that.

*Stream-date random intercept* - `u_stream-date` is a random intercept shared by samples from the same stream on the same date (upstream/downstream pairs and repeated storm samples). It is included only when an analyte has such groups. - `site` is a fixed effect, so site gets its own baseline concentration, because sites differ in geology and chemistry.

*Priors* - Priors: Non informative = Normal(0, 1) on all population-level coefficients, Exponential(1) on sigma, `brms` defaults otherwise.

*Reports* - `burned_only: TRUE` fits only the five burned sites (browns, browns_sub, winters_up, winters_usgs, davis). - Reported: posterior median and `cri` credible interval of exp(b), the multiplicative change in concentration per one SD, plus the contrast exp(b3 - b4) comparing discharge and precipitation effects.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, warning=TRUE, message=TRUE, fig.width=9, fig.height=5)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(brms)
library(knitr)
library(posterior)
dir.create(params$output_dir, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
# Flexible parsers: accept Date/POSIXct as-is, otherwise m/d/yy (or m/d/yyyy), then ISO.
parse_date_flex <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(x)
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) return(as.Date(x, tz="America/Los_Angeles"))
  x <- as.character(x)
  d <- suppressWarnings(lubridate::mdy(x, quiet=TRUE))
  if (mean(is.na(d[!is.na(x)])) > 0.5) d <- suppressWarnings(lubridate::ymd(x, quiet=TRUE))
  d
}
parse_datetime_flex <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) return(lubridate::with_tz(x, "America/Los_Angeles"))
  lubridate::with_tz(lubridate::ymd_hms(x, tz="UTC", quiet=TRUE), "America/Los_Angeles")
}
site_lookup <- tribble(
 ~site_lab, ~stream_id, ~position,
 "browns_sub", "browns", "upstream",
 "browns", "browns", "downstream",
 "winters_up", "winters", "upstream",
 "winters_usgs", "winters", "downstream",
 "ophir", "ophir", "single",
 "davis", "davis", "single"
) %>% mutate(burned = site_lab != "ophir")   # ophir is the only unburned site
analytes <- tribble(
 ~analyte, ~col, ~unit, ~to_mg_L,
 "DOC","DOC_QC","mg/L",1,
 "TOC","TOC_QC","mg/L",1,
 "TDN","TDN_QC","mg/L",1,
 "PO4_P","PO4.P_QC","mg/L",1,
 "NO3_N","NO3.N_QC","mg/L",1,
 "NH4_N","NH4.N_QC","mg/L",1,
 "TSS","TSS_QC","mg/L",1,
 "Al","Al_QC","ug/L",0.001,
 "As","As_QC","ug/L",0.001,
 "B","B_QC","ug/L",0.001,
 "Ba","Ba_QC","ug/L",0.001,
 "Ca","Ca_QC","ug/L",0.001,
 "Cr","Cr_QC","ug/L",0.001,
 "Fe","Fe_QC","ug/L",0.001,
 "Mn","Mn_QC","ug/L",0.001,
 "Pb","Pb_QC","ug/L",0.001,
 "Sr","Sr_QC","ug/L",0.001,
 "Zn","Zn_QC","ug/L",0.001
) %>% mutate(dl_col = sub("_QC$", "_DL_lab", col))
stopifnot(nrow(analytes)==18)
```

## Data organization check of the input files

```{r data_org}
for (f in c(params$chemistry_csv, params$hydro_csv))
  if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Input file not found: ", f, "\n(working directory: ", getwd(), ")", call. = FALSE)

chem_head  <- readr::read_csv(params$chemistry_csv, n_max = 5, show_col_types = FALSE)
hydro_head <- readr::read_csv(params$hydro_csv,     n_max = 5, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Chemistry: site_lab, date, each analyte's *_QC column, and its *_DL_lab flag
# (analytes in params$assume_quantified have no flag column).
need_chem <- c("site_lab", "date", analytes$col,
               analytes$dl_col[!analytes$analyte %in% params$assume_quantified])
miss_chem <- setdiff(need_chem, names(chem_head))

# Hydrology: a site column, a discharge column, and the daily predictors
site_col   <- intersect(c("site_lab", "site"), names(hydro_head))[1]
q_col      <- intersect(c("Q_obs", "Q"), names(hydro_head))[1]
need_hydro <- c("date", "water_year", "precip_mm", "ppt_3day", "season_component", "functional_component")
miss_hydro <- c(if (is.na(site_col)) "site_lab (or site)", if (is.na(q_col)) "Q_obs (or Q)",
                setdiff(need_hydro, names(hydro_head)))

# Site labels must match site_lookup after lower-casing and trimming
chem_sites  <- readr::read_csv(params$chemistry_csv, col_select = any_of("site_lab"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  pull(site_lab) %>% as.character() %>% trimws() %>% str_to_lower() %>% unique()
bad_sites   <- setdiff(chem_sites, site_lookup$site_lab)
hydro_sites <- if (!is.na(site_col))
  readr::read_csv(params$hydro_csv, col_select = all_of(site_col), show_col_types = FALSE)[[1]] %>%
    as.character() %>% trimws() %>% str_to_lower() %>% unique() else character()
no_hydro    <- setdiff(chem_sites, hydro_sites)

cat("Chemistry file:", params$chemistry_csv, "\n  columns:", ncol(chem_head), "| sites:", paste(sort(chem_sites), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Hydrology file:", params$hydro_csv,     "\n  columns:", ncol(hydro_head), "| sites:", paste(sort(hydro_sites), collapse = ", "), "\n")
problems <- c(
  if (length(miss_chem))  paste("Chemistry is missing columns:", paste(miss_chem, collapse = ", ")),
  if (length(miss_hydro)) paste("Hydrology is missing columns:", paste(miss_hydro, collapse = ", ")),
  if (length(bad_sites))  paste("Chemistry site_lab not in site_lookup:", paste(bad_sites, collapse = ", ")),
  if (length(no_hydro))   paste("Chemistry sites with no hydrology rows:", paste(no_hydro, collapse = ", ")))
if (length(problems)) stop("Pre-flight check failed:\n- ", paste(problems, collapse = "\n- "), call. = FALSE)
cat("Pre-model check passed.\n")
```

## 1. Import and validate source measurements

```{r import}
read_required <- function(path, label) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop(label, " not found: ", path, call.=FALSE)
  readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types=FALSE, guess_max=Inf)
}
# Always read the CSV named in params (no in-memory shortcut, so the file you set is the file used).
chem <- read_required(params$chemistry_csv, "Chemistry")
if (!"site_lab" %in% names(chem)) stop("Chemistry must contain site_lab")
if (!"date" %in% names(chem)) stop("Chemistry must contain date")
n_chem_raw <- nrow(chem)
chem <- chem %>% mutate(site_lab=str_to_lower(trimws(as.character(site_lab))),
                        date=parse_date_flex(date),
                        sample_datetime=if ("datetime" %in% names(.))
                          parse_datetime_flex(datetime) else
                          as.POSIXct(date, tz="America/Los_Angeles")) %>%
  left_join(site_lookup, by="site_lab")
if (anyNA(chem$stream_id))
  stop("site_lab values not in site_lookup: ",
       paste(unique(chem$site_lab[is.na(chem$stream_id)]), collapse=", "))
if (anyNA(chem$date)) stop("Missing/unparseable chemistry dates")
# Multiple field collections during a storm are valid observations, not duplicates.
# Preserve each row and audit repeated site/date groups.
storm_repeats <- chem %>% count(site_lab,date,name="n_samples") %>% filter(n_samples>1)
if (nrow(storm_repeats)) {
  message("Repeated site/date field collections retained (storm samples):")
  print(storm_repeats)
}
# Date-only POSIXct values are NOT evidence of distinct sampling times.
chem <- chem %>% mutate(
  sample_id = row_number(),
  storm_event = if_else(date == as.Date("2024-10-16"),
                        "storm_2024_10_16", NA_character_),
  stream_date = interaction(stream_id,date,drop=TRUE)
)
print(chem %>% count(stream_id,site_lab))
print(chem %>% group_by(site_lab) %>% summarise(first=min(date),last=max(date),n=n(),.groups="drop"))
```

```{r flow-import}
# All Q values are directly measured (cross-section or USGS gage). No interpolation,
# rating extrapolation, or transfer of a gage measurement to a different site.

# 1. Load hydrology (one row per site per day) ---------------------------------
# guess_max = Inf: the first ~1000 rows of some columns are NA, so default type
# guessing would mis-type functional_component / season_component.
hydro_raw <- readr::read_csv(params$hydro_csv, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = Inf)
site_col <- intersect(c("site_lab", "site"), names(hydro_raw))[1]
q_col    <- intersect(c("Q_obs", "Q"), names(hydro_raw))[1]
if (is.na(site_col) || is.na(q_col))
  stop("Hydrology file needs a site/site_lab column and a Q_obs (or Q) column. Found: ",
       paste(names(hydro_raw), collapse = ", "))
need_cols <- c("date", "water_year", "precip_mm", "ppt_3day",
               "season_component", "functional_component")
if (length(setdiff(need_cols, names(hydro_raw))))
  stop("Hydrology file is missing: ", paste(setdiff(need_cols, names(hydro_raw)), collapse = ", "))

flow_cross <- hydro_raw %>%
  transmute(
    site_lab = str_to_lower(trimws(as.character(.data[[site_col]]))),
    date = parse_date_flex(date),
    water_year = as.integer(water_year),
    Q_obs = as.numeric(.data[[q_col]]),
    precip_mm = as.numeric(precip_mm),
    ppt_3day = as.numeric(ppt_3day),
    season_component = as.character(season_component),
    functional_component = as.character(functional_component)
  )

# 2. Validate hydrology and site matching --------------------------------------
if (anyNA(flow_cross$date)) stop("Unparseable dates in hydrology file")

flow_duplicates <- flow_cross %>% count(site_lab, date) %>% filter(n > 1)
if (nrow(flow_duplicates) > 0) {
  print(flow_duplicates)
  stop("Duplicate site/date records in hydrology data")
}

unmatched <- setdiff(unique(chem$site_lab), unique(flow_cross$site_lab))
if (length(unmatched))
  stop("Chemistry site_lab values with no hydrology rows: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "),
       ". Hydrology site labels are: ", paste(sort(unique(flow_cross$site_lab)), collapse = ", "))

n_outside <- sum(chem$date < min(flow_cross$date) | chem$date > max(flow_cross$date))
if (n_outside > 0)
  warning(n_outside, " chemistry samples fall outside the hydrology date range")

# 3. Join observed hydrology by site and date ----------------------------------
hydro_vars <- c("water_year", "Q_obs", "Q_source", "match_hours", "match_precision",
                "precip_mm", "ppt_3day", "season_component", "functional_component")

chem <- chem %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  select(-any_of(hydro_vars)) %>%
  left_join(flow_cross, by = c("site_lab", "date"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  mutate(
    Q_source = case_when(
      !is.na(Q_obs) & site_lab %in% c("winters_usgs", "ophir", "davis") ~ "usgs_observed",
      !is.na(Q_obs) ~ "cross_section",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    match_precision = if_else(!is.na(Q_obs), "same_date_only", NA_character_),
    match_hours = NA_real_
  )

# Storm samples must all survive the join
stopifnot(nrow(chem) == n_chem_raw)

# 4. Availability summary ------------------------------------------------------
flow_summary <- chem %>%
  group_by(site_lab) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_Q = sum(!is.na(Q_obs)),
    n_ppt = sum(!is.na(precip_mm)),
    n_ppt3 = sum(!is.na(ppt_3day)),
    n_flow_type = sum(!is.na(functional_component)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(kable(flow_summary))

# 5. Hydrologic predictors (NA stays NA) ---------------------------------------
# Q is in m3/s and these streams are small, so log1p(Q) would be ~linear.
# Convert to L/s first so the transform behaves like a log.
chem <- chem %>%
  mutate(
    logQ = log1p(Q_obs * 1000),
    logPPT = log1p(precip_mm),
    logP3 = log1p(ppt_3day),
    flow_type = factor(functional_component),
    hydro_season = factor(season_component)
  )

if (any(chem$Q_obs < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) stop("Negative discharge values detected")
if (any(chem$precip_mm < 0, na.rm = TRUE) || any(chem$ppt_3day < 0, na.rm = TRUE))
  stop("Negative precipitation values detected")

print(kable(chem %>% count(site_lab, Q_source, match_precision)))
message("Hydrology successfully joined to chemistry data")
```

## 2. Detection-limit metadata and solute-level sample sizes

`*_DL_lab == "yes"` is assumed to indicate a left-censored result; `"no"` indicates quantified. Blank or unknown flags are **not** automatically assumed to be quantified. The value in a censored `*_QC` field must be the actual reporting/detection limit to use it as a censoring bound. If it is a substituted concentration, supply a verified analyte-specific `*_limit` column or update the import. Do not replace limits with zero or half the detection limit.

```{r analyte-long}

# Prepare temporal and hydrologic variables
# before converting analytes to long format


library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

chem <- chem %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),

    # Continuous time in days since first observation
    day_num = as.numeric(
      date - min(date, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),

    # Day of year
    doy = yday(date),

    # Seasonal predictors
    season_sin = sin(2 * pi * doy / 365.25),
    season_cos = cos(2 * pi * doy / 365.25),

    # (logQ, logP3, flow_type are created in the flow-import chunk)

    # Stream-specific sampling occasion
    stream_date = interaction(
      stream_id,
      date,
      drop = TRUE
    ),

    # Sampling event identifier
    storm_event = if_else(
      date == as.Date("2024-10-16"),
      "storm_20241016",
      NA_character_
    )
  )

# Preserve existing sample timestamps if available.
# Otherwise use the date, without implying an exact time.

if (!"sample_datetime" %in% names(chem)) {
  chem <- chem %>%
    mutate(
      sample_datetime = as.POSIXct(
        date,
        tz = "America/Los_Angeles"
      )
    )
}

# Create a unique sample ID if one does not exist
if (!"sample_id" %in% names(chem)) {
  chem <- chem %>%
    mutate(
      sample_id = paste0(
        site_lab, "_",
        format(date, "%Y%m%d"), "_",
        row_number()
      )
    )
}

# Verify required columns
required_vars <- c(
  "row_id", "sample_id", "storm_event",
  "stream_date", "sample_datetime",
  "site_lab", "stream_id", "position",
  "date", "day_num", "doy",
  "season_sin", "season_cos",
  "Q_obs", "Q_source", "match_precision",
  "precip_mm", "ppt_3day",
  "logQ", "logP3", "flow_type"
)

missing_vars <- setdiff(required_vars, names(chem))
if (length(missing_vars)) stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))

available <- analytes %>% filter(col %in% names(chem))
missing <- setdiff(analytes$col,names(chem))
if (length(missing)) warning("Unavailable analytes: ",paste(missing,collapse=", "))
long <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(available)),function(j) {
  a <- available[j,]
  flag <- if (a$dl_col %in% names(chem))
    str_to_lower(trimws(as.character(chem[[a$dl_col]]))) else rep(NA_character_,nrow(chem))
  flag[flag %in% ""] <- NA_character_
  if (!a$dl_col %in% names(chem) && a$analyte %in% params$assume_quantified)
    flag <- rep("no", nrow(chem))
  # If an explicit limit column exists, use it; otherwise use the reported
  # value ONLY AFTER confirming it represents the detection bound.
  limit_col <- paste0(a$col,"_limit")
  limit <- if (limit_col %in% names(chem)) as.numeric(chem[[limit_col]]) else rep(NA_real_,nrow(chem))
  # No explicit limit column: recover the limit from the QC-substituted value
  if (all(is.na(limit)) && params$qc_substitution_factor > 0)
    limit <- if_else(flag %in% "yes", as.numeric(chem[[a$col]]) / params$qc_substitution_factor, NA_real_)
  chem %>% transmute(
    row_id,sample_id,storm_event,stream_date,sample_datetime,site_lab,stream_id,position,date,day_num,doy,season_sin,season_cos,
    Q_obs,Q_source,match_precision,precip_mm,ppt_3day,logQ,logP3,flow_type,
    analyte=a$analyte,unit=a$unit,to_mg_L=a$to_mg_L,
    value=as.numeric(.data[[a$col]]),flag=flag,
    limit=limit,
    censored=case_when(flag=="yes"~TRUE,flag=="no"~FALSE,TRUE~NA),
    # A limit is not inferred from QC-substituted values.
    censor_bound=if_else(flag=="yes",limit,NA_real_)
  )
})



qc <- long %>% group_by(analyte) %>% summarise(
  n_total=sum(!is.na(value)),
  n_quantified=sum(censored==FALSE & !is.na(value),na.rm=TRUE),
  n_censored=sum(censored==TRUE & !is.na(value),na.rm=TRUE),
  n_unknown_flag=sum(is.na(censored) & !is.na(value)),
  n_missing_limit=sum(censored==TRUE & (is.na(censor_bound)|censor_bound<=0),na.rm=TRUE),
  n_Q=sum(!is.na(Q_obs)&!is.na(value)),
  n_ppt3=sum(!is.na(ppt_3day)&!is.na(value)),
  n_sites=n_distinct(site_lab[!is.na(value)]),
  .groups="drop")
qc <- qc %>% mutate(
  prop_censored = if_else(n_quantified + n_censored > 0,
                          n_censored / (n_quantified + n_censored), NA_real_))
print(kable(qc))

write_csv(qc,file.path(params$output_dir,"analyte_QC_summary.csv"))
```

## 3. Model specification actually used

```{r spec}
burned_sites <- site_lookup$site_lab[site_lookup$burned]
scope_label  <- if (params$burned_only) "burned_only" else "all_sites"
pred_label   <- if (params$use_discharge) "Q_and_PPT" else "PPT_only"
out_dir      <- file.path(params$output_dir, paste(scope_label, pred_label, sep = "_"))
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
# Thresholds used to flag models whose posteriors should not be interpreted
max_rhat_ok <- 1.05
min_ess_ok  <- 200
# Which flag decides what is plotted as interpretable:
#   "reliable"      = R-hat + ESS + no divergent transitions (recommended)
#   "reliable_rhat" = R-hat + ESS only (divergent transitions are NOT checked)
reliability_flag <- "reliable"
cat("Scope:", scope_label, "| predictors:", pred_label, "\nOutputs:", out_dir, "\n")

# Which sites can enter the models? A sample needs every predictor in the model.
coverage <- long %>% distinct(sample_id, site_lab, logQ, logP3) %>%
  group_by(site_lab) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = n(), n_with_Q = sum(!is.na(logQ)), n_with_PPT = sum(!is.na(logP3)),
            n_usable = sum(!is.na(logP3) & (!params$use_discharge | !is.na(logQ))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(in_scope = !params$burned_only | site_lab %in% burned_sites,
         enters_models = in_scope & n_usable > 0)
write_csv(coverage, file.path(out_dir, "site_coverage.csv"))
print(kable(coverage))
if (any(coverage$in_scope & coverage$n_usable == 0))
  warning("In-scope sites with no usable rows (missing predictors) are dropped from every model: ",
          paste(coverage$site_lab[coverage$in_scope & coverage$n_usable == 0], collapse = ", "))
```

## 4. Fit the censored Bayesian models

```{r bayes-functions}
fit_bayes <- function(a) {
  d <- long %>% filter(analyte == a, !is.na(value), !is.na(censored), !is.na(logP3))
  if (params$use_discharge) d <- d %>% filter(!is.na(logQ))
  if (params$burned_only)   d <- d %>% filter(site_lab %in% burned_sites)
  if (any(d$censored & (is.na(d$censor_bound) | d$censor_bound <= 0)))
    stop("Missing verified censor bounds for ", a)
  d <- d %>% mutate(
      censor      = if_else(censored, "left", "none"),
      y           = if_else(censored, censor_bound, value),
      ppt_z       = as.numeric(scale(logP3)),
      q_z         = if (params$use_discharge) as.numeric(scale(logQ)) else NA_real_,
      stream_date = interaction(stream_id, date, drop = TRUE),
      site_lab    = factor(site_lab)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(y), y > 0, is.finite(ppt_z))
  if (params$use_discharge) d <- d %>% filter(is.finite(q_z))
  if (nrow(d) < params$min_n || n_distinct(d$site_lab) < 2) {
    message(a, ": too few rows or sites; not fit"); return(NULL)
  }
  rhs <- c("site_lab", if (params$use_discharge) "q_z", "ppt_z", "season_sin", "season_cos")
  if (any(table(d$stream_date) > 1)) rhs <- c(rhs, "(1 | stream_date)")
  form <- bf(as.formula(paste("y | cens(censor) ~", paste(rhs, collapse = " + "))))
  brm(form, data = d, family = lognormal(),
      prior = c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"), prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma")),
      chains = params$chains, iter = params$iter,
      cores = min(params$chains, parallel::detectCores()),
      seed = 2026, control = list(adapt_delta = params$adapt_delta),
      refresh = 0, silent = 2)
}
```

```{r bayes-fit}
# Every analyte with known detection flags and verified limits is fit.
eligible <- qc %>% filter(n_unknown_flag == 0, n_missing_limit == 0) %>% pull(analyte)
fits <- setNames(lapply(eligible, function(a) {
  message("Fitting ", a)
  tryCatch(fit_bayes(a), error = function(e) { message(a, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
}), eligible)
saveRDS(fits, file.path(out_dir, "bayesian_models.rds"))
```

## 5. Coefficients and credible intervals (the reported results)

Effects are **multiplicative changes in concentration per one-SD increase** in the predictor (exp of the posterior coefficient), with the `cri` credible interval. `supported` means the interval excludes 1. `reliable` is FALSE when R-hat, effective sample size, or divergent transitions fail the thresholds in the `spec` chunk; do not interpret unreliable rows.

```{r bayes-summary}
summarise_fit <- function(fit, a) {
  dr <- posterior::as_draws_df(fit)
  d  <- fit$data
  vars <- intersect(c("b_q_z", "b_ppt_z", "sigma", "sd_stream_date__Intercept"),
                    posterior::variables(dr))
  dg <- posterior::summarise_draws(posterior::subset_draws(dr, variable = vars),
                                   rhat = posterior::rhat, ess_bulk = posterior::ess_bulk,
                                   ess_tail = posterior::ess_tail)
  stopifnot(all(c("rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail") %in% names(dg)), all(is.finite(dg$rhat)), all(is.finite(dg$ess_bulk)))
  np <- brms::nuts_params(fit)
  diag <- tibble(
    n = nrow(d), n_censored = sum(d$censor == "left"),
    pct_censored = 100 * mean(d$censor == "left"),
    rho_Q_PPT = if ("q_z" %in% names(d)) suppressWarnings(cor(d$q_z, d$ppt_z, method = "spearman")) else NA_real_,
    max_rhat = max(dg$rhat), min_ess_bulk = min(dg$ess_bulk), min_ess_tail = min(dg$ess_tail),
    divergences = sum(np$Value[np$Parameter == "divergent__"]))
  get_term <- function(b, label) {
    q <- unname(quantile(b, c((1 - params$cri) / 2, 1 - (1 - params$cri) / 2)))
    tibble(term = label, fold = exp(median(b)), lo = exp(q[1]), hi = exp(q[2]),
           prob_direction = max(mean(b > 0), mean(b < 0)), supported = q[1] > 0 | q[2] < 0)
  }
  out <- list()
  if ("b_q_z" %in% vars) out$q <- get_term(dr$b_q_z, "Streamflow")
  out$p <- get_term(dr$b_ppt_z, "Precipitation")
  if ("b_q_z" %in% vars) out$c <- get_term(dr$b_q_z - dr$b_ppt_z, "Streamflow vs precipitation")
  bind_rows(out) %>% mutate(analyte = a, .before = 1) %>% bind_cols(diag)
}
fits_ok <- Filter(Negate(is.null), fits)
if (!length(fits_ok)) stop("No models were fit; see the messages from the bayes-fit chunk.")
coef_tab <- purrr::imap_dfr(fits_ok, ~ summarise_fit(.x, .y)) %>%
  mutate(reliable = max_rhat <= max_rhat_ok & min_ess_bulk >= min_ess_ok & divergences == 0,
         reliable_rhat = max_rhat <= max_rhat_ok & min_ess_bulk >= min_ess_ok, 
         scope = scope_label, predictors = pred_label)
coef_tab <- coef_tab %>% mutate(plot_ok = if (reliability_flag == "reliable") reliable else reliable_rhat)
write_csv(coef_tab, file.path(out_dir, "bayesian_coefficients.csv"))

coef_tab %>%
  transmute(analyte, term, effect = sprintf("%.2f", fold),
            CrI = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", lo, hi), supported, n, pct_censored = round(pct_censored),
            rhat = round(max_rhat, 3), divergences, reliable) %>%
  kable()
```

```{r bayes-plot, echo=F, include= T, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
terms_plot <- intersect(c("Streamflow", "Precipitation"), unique(coef_tab$term))
plot_dat <- coef_tab %>% filter(term %in% terms_plot) %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("%s (%d%% cens.)", analyte, round(pct_censored)),
         term = factor(term, levels = terms_plot))
ord <- plot_dat %>% filter(term == terms_plot[length(terms_plot)]) %>% arrange(fold) %>% pull(label)
plot_dat <- plot_dat %>% mutate(label = factor(label, levels = ord))



# 1. Prepare plotting data

plot_dat <- plot_dat %>%
  filter(plot_ok==TRUE & pct_censored<70) %>%
  mutate(
    term = factor(
      as.character(term),
      levels = c("Streamflow", "Precipitation")
    ),

    plot_ok = factor(
      as.character(plot_ok),
      levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"),
      labels = c("Reliable", "Unreliable")
    ),

    # Match fill to term when reliable; white otherwise
    point_fill = case_when(
      plot_ok == "Unreliable" ~ "Unreliable",
      TRUE ~ as.character(term)
    )
  )

# Shared position adjustment
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)


# 2. Plot

p <- ggplot(
  plot_dat,
  aes(
    x = fold,
    y = label,
    colour = term,
    shape = term,
    group = term
  )
) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +

  # Credible intervals colored by term
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = lo,
      xmax = hi
    ),
    orientation = "y",
    position = pd,
    width = 0,
    linewidth = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +

  # Points with predictor-specific fill or white fill
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = point_fill),
    position = pd,
    size = 2.5,
    stroke = 0.9
  ) +

  # Circle = Streamflow; Triangle = Precipitation
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Streamflow" = 21,
      "Precipitation" = 24
    ),
    name = "Predictor"
  ) +

  # Outline and interval colors
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Streamflow" = "#303030",
      "Precipitation" = "#084594"
    ),
    name = "Predictor"
  ) +

  # Fill colors
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Streamflow" = "#303030",
      "Precipitation" = "#084594",
      "Unreliable" = "white"
    ),
    name = "Point fill"
  ) +

  scale_x_log10() +

  labs(
    x = sprintf(
      "Change in concentration per 1 SD (median and %d%% CrI)",
      round(100 * params$cri)
    ),
    y = NULL
  ) +

  guides(
   # colour = "none",
    shape = guide_legend(order = 1),
    fill = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p)
```

## 6. Record of model run

This table and `bayesian_coefficients.csv` are the single record of the model output being interpreted.

```{r manifest}
sites_used <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(fits, function(f) if (!is.null(f)) as.character(f$data$site_lab)))))
model_spec <- tibble(
  item = c("scope", "sites_in_models", "predictors", "likelihood", "random_effect", "priors",
           "chains_x_iter", "adapt_delta", "seed", "interval", "run_date", "brms_version",
           "chemistry_csv", "hydrology_csv"),
  value = c(scope_label, paste(sites_used, collapse = ", "), pred_label,
            "lognormal, left-censored at sample-specific reporting limit",
            "(1 | stream_date) when same-stream, same-date groups exist",
            "b ~ Normal(0,1); sigma ~ Exponential(1); brms defaults otherwise",
            paste(params$chains, "x", params$iter), params$adapt_delta, 2026,
            paste0(100 * params$cri, "%"), as.character(Sys.Date()),
            as.character(packageVersion("brms")), params$chemistry_csv, params$hydro_csv))
write_csv(model_spec, file.path(out_dir, "model_spec.csv"))
kable(model_spec)
```
